sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the difference between the encompassing light drawn through the natural service of the Elokis soul and the higher encompassing light drawn specifically through the refinement of darkness.

translations.translation: And he continues in the maamar,
that it is necessary to understand,
behold, even through the service of the Elokis soul from its own side,
like in the service of prayer through contemplation in G-dliness in matters that are not related to the animal soul, and likewise in the occupation with Torah,
an addition of light is drawn into the Elokis soul,
for every addition of light
[and especially that the addition of light drawn through prayer and occupation with Torah is an addition that is greater than the original],
is from the encompassing light,
and what is the advantage that is accomplished specifically through the refinement of darkness?
[And it can be said,
that this that he brings in the maamar an example from the service of prayer
(service)
and occupation with Torah and not from the fulfillment of commandments
(acts of kindness),
because the commandments,
since their matter is
commandments to man and the intention in them is in order to refine the creations,
necessarily the refinement that is accomplished through them in the body and animal soul is in some revelation
(even when his fulfillment of commandments is in a manner of the service of the soul from its own side),
but not so the occupation with Torah,
since the Torah is the word of G-d,
the wisdom of the Holy One, blessed be He,
except that it descended below and became invested in the intellect of man,
therefore it is possible that the refinement and purification of the physical brain that is accomplished through this will not be felt,
therefore in the occupation with Torah
it is more applicable that the occupation be from the side of the soul].
And he explains regarding this,
that in the encompassing [light] there are two levels.
As is known,
that in concealment
[for encompassing is a level of concealment]
there are two aspects.
A concealment that exists in actuality,
like the fire that is within the coal,
that while it is hidden and covered in the coal, it is an existence of fire,
therefore through water the fire in the coal can be extinguished,
and a concealment that does not exist in actuality,
like the fire in the flint that can never be extinguished because it is not an existence of fire.
And the distinction between these two aspects is also in the manner of their revelation from their concealment.
For the extraction and revelation of fire from the coal is through blowing with a bellows,
and the extraction of fire from the flint is specifically through striking with exertion.
And this is the advantage of the encompassing [light] that is drawn specifically through the refinement of darkness,
for the encompassing [light] that is drawn through the service of the Elokis soul is an encompassing that relates to the internal,
and in general—a concealment that exists in actuality,
therefore its drawing and revelation is through the service of the Elokis soul from its own side
(in which there is not so much exertion,
analogous to blowing with a bellows),
but not so the encompassing [light] that is drawn through the service of the refinement of darkness,
which is great exertion,
it is the encompassing that does not relate to the internal,
and in general—a concealment that does not exist in actuality,
the essential concealment.
And this is, "When the sitra achra is subdued, the glory of the Holy One, blessed be He, is elevated, etc.,"
the essential concealment that is completely removed from the aspect of internality.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the elevation drawn through subduing the sitra achra is greater because the exertion involved is even more immense than that of refinement.

translations.translation: And based on this, the greatness of the elevation of the drawing that comes through subduing the sitra achra will be understood,
for the service of subduing the sitra achra while it is in its strength and might
[and especially the subduing in these matters that comes through an immense war]
is a great and immense exertion even more than the exertion in the service of refinements,
therefore,
the concealment that is drawn through this
("the glory of the Holy One, blessed be He, is elevated")
is more elevated even than the concealment drawn through the service of refinements
("subduing" in the aforementioned maamar).

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the primary advantage of subduing the sitra achra is that it reveals the supernal treasure from above, and at the completion of the victory in the future redemption, the treasure itself will be revealed.

translations.translation: And behold, this elevation in the service of subduing,
since the drawing is through service and exertion
(analogous to the extraction of fire from flint through striking),
is analogous to the drawing through the exertion of the service of refinements,
except that it is more elevated.
However,
the primary advantage of subduing the sitra achra is,
that the service of subduing the sitra achra while it is in its strength and might is in a manner of victory,
through which is the revelation of the supernal treasure,
for this revelation is from above and no arousal from below reaches there.
And there is another matter in this,
that this revelation is drawn into internality
(the elevation in the arousal from above that is drawn through the arousal from below),
and as explained above
(section 10)
that the revelation and drawing of the treasure is like in an investment in the attribute of Netzach in man.
Except that now,
when the victory is not yet revealed
(for they are still in the midst of the war),
that which is felt in man in revelation is not the treasure itself, only the result of it,
that he has the power to overcome the opponent.
And at the completion of the victory,
when the victory will be revealed,
then the treasure itself will be felt in revelation,
in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,
very soon.
